description: 轮次结束、会话开始与结束时登记会话记录并唤醒后台同步，网络提交在脱离 Claude Code 的进程中完成；写入与更新记忆前为工具参数补上当前一轮的信息。

hooks.command: "${HIVEMEMORY_PYTHON:-$(command -v python3 || command -v python)}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hivememory_hook.py" claude-code hook PreToolUse
"${HIVEMEMORY_PYTHON:-$(command -v python3 || command -v python)}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hivememory_hook.py" claude-code hook Stop
"${HIVEMEMORY_PYTHON:-$(command -v python3 || command -v python)}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hivememory_hook.py" claude-code hook StopFailure
"${HIVEMEMORY_PYTHON:-$(command -v python3 || command -v python)}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hivememory_hook.py" claude-code hook SessionStart
"${HIVEMEMORY_PYTHON:-$(command -v python3 || command -v python)}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hivememory_hook.py" claude-code hook SessionEnd
